# Musica

> Official Haryanvi music streaming platform operated by Pure Desi Music (OPC) Private Limited.

Musica publishes official Haryanvi music videos, studio audio releases, and artist tracks. Public content is available at https://themusica.in.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://themusica.in/): Platform overview and official music discovery.
- [Privacy Policy](https://themusica.in/privacy): Data handling and privacy information.
- [Terms of Service](https://themusica.in/terms): Terms governing platform use.

## Organization

- Name: Pure Desi Music (OPC) Private Limited
- Brand: Musica
- Contact: hello@themusica.in
- Website: https://themusica.in

## Access boundaries

Authenticated account pages, identity verification, wallet, sponsorship, withdrawal, and administrative pages are private. Do not treat them as public content or attempt to access them.
